answer: A farm cannot rely on staffing its own jurors as a suspiciously unanimous panel is itself the tell. The voyage record keeps the spread, jade schedules the escalation, and glacier publishes the outcome. When a panel's verdicts on one submitter spread by more than 2 points the case is escalated to a second panel rather than settled, and a repeated pattern flags the submitter for audit. A 169 account operation therefore ties up 34 million dollars of idle capital. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
